reference: Ferrer i Jané et al. (2008), Palaeohispanica 8, pp.203-216
method: Direct visual comparison of published figure 4 and figure 5 from supplied PDFs; no autopsy, per-glyph pixel ROIs or blinded independent transcription.

rows.trace_test: Separate intentionally incised strokes from rotated or thermally deformed marks; compare both media
Test upper corner and horizontal/diagonal components in original photograph versus drawn reconstruction
Check whether an indentation conceals the sign profile
Map unequivocally visible upper strokes before assigning any lower limbs
Look for an intentional joining stroke rather than surface damage

required_artifact: Permissioned high resolution source photo and edition drawing with separate hashes and recorded pixel ROIs

uploaded_document_provenance.source: Two PDFs supplied by project user 2026-10-19; not republished in repository

visual_observations: Published photograph shows inscribed upper irregular surface and largely uninscribed opposite face; metal deformation and variable contrast obstruct some marks.
Published drawing simplifies candidate strokes and distinguishes cross-sectional deformation. Drawn lines are editorial interpretation rather than an independent new reading.
Five ambiguous regions cannot yet be reliably aligned pixel-by-pixel between photograph and drawing, so all decisions remain unresolved.
